prompts: Use case: stylized-concept, production pixel-art game background. Reference image: the existing lavender companion-room foreground (style reference, not UI). Expand this room into ONE complete OPAQUE wide panorama, 2176x1088, edge-to-edge with no transparency or fades. Keep the exact cozy pixel-art world: lavender walls, warm pale wood desk, violet cushions, golden potted flowers and trailing plants, small pinned pictures and notes, heart-decorated purple laptop on the LEFT of the desk. Front-on view from the visitor sitting opposite, mild room depth. A large simple rectangular window occupies x~7%-35%, y~10%-49%, with matching warm cream/lavender frame and a muted featureless blue-gray sky inside; app replaces this pane with dynamic scenery. Full continuous desk crosses the width around y=67%-73%; below it keep a quieter wooden front/soft textile area for a translucent dialogue overlay. Leave an empty seat at x=53% for the app's existing girl sprite and clear desktop at x=72% for the existing cat. No drawn people or animals at all. A small cozy desk lamp on the cabinet at far right, natural unlit pale shade. Fill the whole upper background and both edges with harmonious room wall/furniture/plants; do not leave blank white gutters. Match the reference's fine lavender pixel clusters and warm cream/pink palette, crisp recognizable pixels, no blurry painting or photorealism. This is background ART only: no cards, interface, text, lettering, speech bubbles, borders, buttons or watermarks. Preserve a clear, straight table support line for characters; laptop entirely visible. Daytime neutral warm light, later app adds dusk/night grading.

Targeted composition edit of the supplied production pixel-art room. Keep the exact 2:1 panorama, style, colors, walls, plants, shelves and lamp, with NO people, cats, text, UI or transparency. Move the entire desk/tabletop, complete laptop and backs of the empty chairs UP so that the rear edge of the tabletop is at y=65% of the full image height (currently near 79%). Keep its perspective and horizontal alignment coherent. The room below that edge becomes a taller continuous pale wood desk front / quiet foreground for an application dialogue overlay. Keep the large rectangular window in the left side but shorten its bottom to fit naturally above the new table height, retaining its frame and blank blue-gray pane. Laptop must be complete, seated on the raised table, towards the left. Empty seating area around center x55%, empty tabletop for cat around x73%. Keep the intricate warm lavender pixel-art room identity, fine pixels, full edge-to-edge coverage; do not add any interface, text, characters or animated marks. Important: table rear edge at 65% image height, not 79%.
selection: Expanded original room, then raised the table to make space for the confirmed bottom dialogue. No characters baked into the plate. Existing complete character and cat sprites remain runtime rendered; matching outfits and appearance data are preserved.
runtime: Draw in a 2176x1088 virtual plane at a uniform scale. Protect the character, cat and laptop above the dialogue; on taller viewports continue only the lower wooden desk front below the plate, without stretching the actors or room. Window palette matte preserves foreground plants. Dusk/night lighting and warm lamp are runtime layers.
sourceRights: Same source-room rights boundary as earlier generated assets. No third-party art downloaded.
